$comment: Hand-maintained corrections layered over the Flickr import, keyed by slug.
Any field of the albums schema may appear here; it wins over the imported value.
Flickr is accurate about the photos and terse about the album. The field
most worth writing here is `description` — Flickr album descriptions are
usually empty, and a sentence about where you were and why does more for
the page than any amount of metadata.
`title` is also fair game: album names on Flickr tend to be functional.
`npm run albums:check` writes nothing and lists what would change.
